head.t: Prospective Randomized Controlled Trial of Three Different Types of Webspace Reconstruction for Congenital Syndactyly Release
head.x: Release of syndactyly includes the use of full-thickness skin grafts or graftless techniques with specially designed flaps. Recently, artificial dermal substitutes have been reported to be successfully used for web reconstruction without skin grafting.
head.s: Journal of Plastic, Reconstructive & Aesthetic Surgery
